question: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is known for which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct anwer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma**, popularly known as **Satyam**, was **an Indian classical dancer **and **choreographer**.
 
• He is **considered **by many as **one of the leading exponents **of the **classical dance **form of **Kuchipudi**.
